name: game-control
description: Start and stop the game in Roblox Studio. Hub-side operations using physical automation.
author: white-dragon-tools

tools.name: startGame
tools.description: Start the game (like F5). Studio enters play state.

mode.description: play (client+server, default) or run (server only, like F8)

tools.name: stopGame
tools.description: Stop the game (like Shift+F5). Studio returns to edit state.
